School of Computer Science · University of Galway

Dr. Mamoona
Asghar

Senior Lecturer in Computer Science

My research brings together cybersecurity, privacy engineering and the analysis of visual data.

I am based at the University of Galway, Ireland. My academic work spans research, teaching and supervision, with experience in Ireland, the UK and Pakistan. I hold a PhD in Computing and Electronic Systems from the University of Essex (2013), and am a former Marie Skłodowska-Curie research fellow.

Research

Security, privacy and intelligent systems

Cybersecurity

Cryptography, malware analysis, intrusion detection and the investigation of emerging cyber threats.

Privacy engineering

Privacy in video surveillance, secure multimedia systems and data protection by design.

Visual data & AI

Computer vision, image and video analysis, deep learning and edge analytics.
